newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Hero to launch 2.6-for-10 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Hero to launch 2.6-for-10 rights issue.

text.p: Shanghai Hero plans to launch a 2.6-for-10 rights issue at a price above 2.50 yuan by May 29, 1997, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The statement said the issue had been approved by a shareholders' meeting on November 29.

Shanghai Hero, one of China's biggest producers of pens, plans to invest the proceeds from the issue to increase production of pens, gas ovens and kitchen equipment and set up a company to produce plastic and steel door frames, it said.
Before the rights issue, Shanghai Hero had a total share capital of 164.5 million shares.
Trading of Shanghai Hero was suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume this afternoon, the statement said.
